tool_schemas.name: google_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Google search through the Serper proxy for the provided query and localization options, records an audit entry tied to the authenticated API key, and returns the upstream result payload (in the requested result_format) along with stored usage/metric fields for the request. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use the endpoint or to set allow_empty_query, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the key’s rate limit or quota would be exceeded. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when q is empty (unless allow_empty_query is true and permitted), or when locale/country/safe_search/result_format are invalid or inconsistent with the schema.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits/quotas for this Google search request.

locale.description: Locale/language hint for results (e.g., en, en-US).

country.description: Country code to localize results (e.g., US, GB).

allow_empty_query.description: Whether to allow an empty query (overrides default only if the API key permits it).

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API key identity and its current entitlements, including status, configured quotas/rate limits, and current window consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and retrieve identity, scopes/entitlements, and current quota/rate-limit usage.

tool_schemas.name: list_api_keys
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys visible to the authenticated caller, with optional filtering by status/owner and pagination. Returns key metadata (never the raw secret), including quota/rate limit configuration and last-used timestamps. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to list keys.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate this management request.

key_prefix.description: Filter by key prefix (useful for searching without exposing secrets).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key with the requested label and quota/rate-limit configuration and returns the newly created key once (plus metadata). The raw API key secret is only returned at creation time; subsequent fetches return prefix/hash only. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to create keys.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate this management request.

owner_type.description: Owner type for the new key.

owner_id.description: Owner identifier for the new key.

allow_empty_query.description: Whether this key is allowed to submit an empty query.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable settings for an existing API key (label, quotas, rate limits, allow_empty_query). Does not return or accept the raw API key secret. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the key id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify it, and rejects invalid quota/rate-limit values.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate this management request.

id.description: Primary id of the API key to update.

quota_requests_per_day.description: New daily success quota; 0 means unlimited.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: New per-minute request cap; 0 means unlimited.

allow_empty_query.description: Whether this key is allowed to submit an empty query.

tool_schemas.name: set_api_key_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an API key lifecycle status to active, suspended, or revoked. Enforces allowed transitions (active↔suspended, active→revoked, suspended→revoked) and refuses conflicts for illegal transitions. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the key id does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage it.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate this management request.

id.description: Primary id of the API key whose status will be changed.

status.description: New status to apply to the API key.

reason.description: Optional audit reason for the status change.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded search request audit entries for the authenticated caller, with optional filtering by status/time range and pagination. Returns request metadata and metrics; does not include raw upstream payload (use the stored result via the request id when available). Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to view these records.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and scope which audit records may be listed.

from_created_at.description: Filter to requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

to_created_at.description: Filter to requests created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Serper Google Search Server
metadata.description: This backend stores API consumers, their credentials, and an audit trail of Google search requests executed through the Serper-powered search proxy.
